placements.why: The content describes an established organizational onboarding process — a mandatory checklist with specific components that replaced a prior wiki page — which calls for an organizational strata category to hold operational-practice themes. Nothing in the existing (empty) strata covers this.
placements.title: Operational practices become institutional routines
placements.frame: What routines, processes, and practices does the organization ratify as standard?

placements.title: From wiki page to mandated checklist
placements.frame: How does an onboarding routine become the established standard that supersedes prior practice?
placements.why: Both segments perform the establishment of the Pallasine checklist as the operative onboarding process: src-1 states its mandatory components (accounts, pairing rotation, shadow shift) as settled present-tense practice with legitimate authority and decision conviction; src-2 grounds that settlement in a supersession event — the checklist replaced the old wiki page last quarter. The theme is how onboarding becomes institutionalized process, a subject future envelopes will keep feeding.
